thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 06/07/2018: TWTR, FB, TEUM, FB, CMTL

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 06/07/2018: TWTR, FB, TEUM, FB, CMTL
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.1%
AAPL: +0.1%
IBM: +0.1%
CSCO: -0.01%
GOOG: -0.1%
Technology shares were mostly firmer ahead of Thursday's open.
Expected movers:
- Twitter ( TWTR ): priced a private offering of $1 billion 0.25% convertible senior notes due 2024
- Facebook ( FB ): unveiled collaborating with news organizations such as ABC, CNN and Univision to develop original news programs that will appear in its Watch video service, the Associated Press reported.
- Comtech Telecommunications ( CMTL ): reported better-than-expected fiscal Q3 results; raised full year outlook
Other news:
- Pareteum Corp. ( TEUM ): agreed to acquire the UK enterprise software developer Artilium in a deal valued at GBP78 million or $105 million
